name: CP2 - common pipeline, Round 1 frozen configuration
frozen: 2026-11-27 (operator: finish today; README_UPDATE_02 not available, its 15:00 default used as guidance)

input_adapter.video: MediaPipe FaceLandmarker 478 landmarks (Python 3.11, mediapipe 1.2.3), largest face then nearest-centroid target, 1-Euro (1 Hz, beta 0.02) -> 10 anatomical patches shared/patches.json
input_adapter.aipex: 3 pre-cropped ROI videos used as patches, no face detection (README 8.5: only allowed dataset-specific setting)

pixels: skin mask (config/face_config.json YCbCr box) + specular removal (Y > 0.95*255 or channel >= 250) + 10/10 % trimmed mean; patch valid if >= 20 px

hr.fusion: per-window SNR-weighted spectral fusion, weights max(SNR_lin-1,0), top-k 5 (all patches when fewer)
hr.video_level: peak of the averaged fused spectrum (one-value references only)

flags_off: motion suppression (E018 not testable on AiPEX)

dev_evidence.aipex_dev_source: outputs/aipex_iter E019 (n.s. vs best single-dataset config E010 8.39)
